Theme

ball noun

also inflatable ball, play ball, fly ball, ball game

classical

Traupman 44

pila, pilae f.

noun, first declension

An ancient ball noun; modern sports need context.

Other words

  • follis, follis m. — inflatable ball

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Traupman 44

    An ancient ball noun.

Examples

  • Pilā lūdere

    play ballcomposed

  • Pilam ad mē mitte.

    Throw the ball to me.composed

  • Pilā lūdō.

    I play ball.Traupman 41

  • pila volāns

    a fly ball (in baseball)Traupman 45

  • lūsus pilae (follis)

    a ball gameTraupman 44
